_doc: Stream B. Terrain added at bake time so a zone's ground matches stream E's archetype (lead ruling 2026-10-04: the bake adds the water rather than E renaming the theme). tools/lib/zone-theme.mjs carves it; keyed by world zone. theme: mere (lakes) | shore (a big lake with a beach, by the hub town) | marsh (a fen of shallow pools round a deeper mere, painted marsh). cliff: a face beside a road (tools/lib/zone-theme.mjs cutCliff) — the_long_stair.

cliff.for: the_long_stair (stream E hook at its foot)
